notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn.
description:
Cast Archaeomancer from your graveyard by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Archaeomancer, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
